name: find_datasheet
description: Find and display a component or board datasheet as a PDF in the HUD viewer. Use when the user asks for a datasheet, pinout, reference manual, or product brief for a named part or dev board.

parameters.description: The part number, module name, or product name to look up, e.g. 'Raspberry Pi 5', 'ESP32-S3-WROOM-1', 'STM32F407', 'Arduino Uno R4'.
Optional custom title for the HUD panel header. Omit to use the default 'DATASHEET — [part]' header.
